## Goal
Document one focused operational improvement for maintainers.

## Process
1. Confirm prerequisites and scope.
2. Execute the smallest safe change set.
3. Validate expected outcomes.
4. Record result and follow-up actions.

## Completion Criteria

- Validation is explicit.
- Fallback guidance is included.
